name: Shri Ram Darbar Divine Murti Set
shortDesc: Vibrantly hand-painted Shri Ram Darbar set featuring Ram, Sita, Lakshman, Hanuman & Bharat with gold crowns.
description: Sculpted with immense devotion at Prem Shankar Murti Kala Kendra. Features Bhagwan Ram and Sita Mata seated on a gold throne, flanked by Lakshman, Bharat, and Hanuman ji offering prayers.

name: Goddess Sherawali Durga Mata Murti
shortDesc: Hand-sculpted 8-armed Goddess Durga riding her majestic lion with intricate gold crown and weapons.
description: Breathtaking murti of Mata Rani riding her lion. Features fine jewel work, 8-arm weapons, red saree detailing, and a golden Mukut halo.

name: Shri Ram, Sita Mata & Lakshman Standing Trio
shortDesc: Standing statue trio of Lord Ram, Sita Mata, and Lakshman with golden bows and lotus bases.
description: Elegant standing idols sculpted for home mandirs and temple altars. Hand-painted with delicate pastel tones and gold ornaments.

name: Painted Lord Ganesha Statue
shortDesc: Vibrantly hand-painted Lord Ganesha idol with gold leaf highlights and detailed ornaments.
description: Masterfully crafted by Prem Shankar. Combines Plaster of Paris (POP) for sharp detail with organic mitti coating.

name: Hand-Molded Shivlinga & Mahadev Relief
shortDesc: Sacred Mahadev Shivlinga surrounded by carved Nandi and Trishul motifs.
description: Sculpted with devotion using pure mitti and POP foundation for long-lasting structural strength.

name: Desi Mitti Ki Handi with Lid (Cookware on Clay Chulha)
shortDesc: Traditional earthenware cooking pot with fitted clay lid, designed for slow cooking on gas stove or mud chulha.
description: Baked in firewood kilns by Prem Shankar artisans. This classic mitti handi retains essential nutrients and imparts an unmatchable traditional earthen aroma.

name: Mitti Ki Heavy Kadai with Handles (Clay Wok)
shortDesc: Deep earthen cooking wok with built-in clay handles, pre-conditioned for frying and sautéing.

name: Clay Water Bottle, Mug & Utensil Collection
shortDesc: Complete collection of natural earthen utensils: eco-friendly clay water bottles, mugs, tea pots & bowls.

specs.Items Included: Clay Bottle, Mug, Teapot & Cooking Bowls

name: Desi Mitti Ka Matka (Earthen Water Pot)

description: Provides micro-porous natural cooling that keeps drinking water chilled and alkaline without electricity.

shortDesc: Authentic earthenware cups for serving special chai, lassi, and sweet milk with earthen fragrance.
